errors.description: time_adjust_q is a multi-bit value produced in rtc_clk and sampled directly in cpu_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
adjust_pulse_q is a one-cycle rtc_clk pulse consumed directly in cpu_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
adjust_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample cpu_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in cpu_event_o.
slew_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector slew_mode_q before decoding in cpu_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
rtc_rst_n is used as data inside cpu_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
aon_snapshot_q combines rtc_clk payload state with cpu_clk status state in aon_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
